The purpose of this script is to run random forests for DOC and NO3 effect sizes using catchment characteristics

Script Workflow:

Step 1) Load in the dataframe from the random forest analysis 

Step 2) Plot it by variables of interest! 


# Library download # 
```{r Load packages}
#for Jake/mac

rm(list=ls(all=T)) #this clears your Environment

require(pacman)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(tidymodels)
library(PNWColors)
library(ranger)
library(here)
library(readr)

```

1. load random forest dataset 
```{r load data}
all_data <- read_csv("~/GitHub/rc_sfa-rc-3-wenas-meta/Output_for_analysis/08_Meta_summary_stats/random_forest_nonnormal_orig_both_analytes.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols= c(Effect_size, Effect_size_no_watershed),
    names_to = "normalization",
    values_to = "Effect_size"
  )

```

2. Plot time since fire 

```{r tsf}
vn = expression(paste(""*N*O[3]^"-"))
dose.labs <- as_labeller(c("DOC" = "DOC", "NO3" = "Nitrate"))

tsf = all_data %>%
  mutate(response_var = stringr::str_remove(response_var, "_Interp")) %>%
   group_by(Time_Since_Fire, response_var, normalization) %>%
  summarise(mean_effect = mean(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_effect = sd(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_effect = n(),
            Effect_size = mean(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(se_effect = sd_effect / sqrt(n_effect),
         lower_ci_effect = mean_effect - qt(1 - (0.05 / 2), n_effect - 1) * se_effect,
         upper_ci_effect = mean_effect + qt(1 - (0.05 / 2), n_effect - 1) * se_effect)
View(tsf)

 tsf_plot = tsf %>% ggplot(aes(Time_Since_Fire, Effect_size, color = normalization))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = mean_effect - se_effect, ymax = mean_effect + se_effect,
                      color = normalization)) +
  facet_grid(~response_var, labeller = dose.labs) +
     scale_color_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800"),
                     guide = guide_legend(title = "Normalization"),
                     labels = c('Normalized Effect Size', 'Non-Normalized Effect Size')) +
  xlab("Time Since Fire") +
  ylab("Effect Size") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "red") +
      theme_bw()

tsf_plot
```

2. plot climate 
```{r climate}
vn = expression(paste(""*N*O[3]^"-"))
dose.labs <- as_labeller(c("DOC" = "DOC", "NO3" = "Nitrate"))

climate <- all_data %>%
  mutate(response_var = stringr::str_remove(response_var, "_Interp")) %>%
   group_by(Climate, response_var, normalization) %>%
  summarise(mean_effect = mean(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_effect = sd(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_effect = n(),
            Effect_size = mean(Effect_size, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(se_effect = sd_effect / sqrt(n_effect),
         lower_ci_effect = mean_effect - qt(1 - (0.05 / 2), n_effect - 1) * se_effect,
         upper_ci_effect = mean_effect + qt(1 - (0.05 / 2), n_effect - 1) * se_effect)
View(climate)

climate_plot <- climate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Effect_size, Climate, color = normalization))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean_effect - se_effect, xmax = mean_effect + se_effect,
                      color = normalization)) +
  facet_grid(~response_var, labeller = dose.labs) +
     scale_color_manual(values = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800"),
                     guide = guide_legend(title = "Normalization"),
                     labels = c('Normalized Effect Size', 'Non-Normalized Effect Size')) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels=c("Dsb" = "Mediterranean", 
                            "Dfc" = "Subarctic",
                            "Dfb" = "Warm-humid",
                            "Csb" = "Warm-Mediterranean",
                            "Csa" = "Hot-Mediterranean",
                            "Cfb" = "Subtropical highland",
                            "Cfa" = "Humid subtropical",
                            "BSk" = "Cold semi-arid")) +
  ylab("Koppen (Climate Classification)") +
  xlab("Effect Size") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "red") +
      theme_bw()

climate_plot
```
